notes: Reached FR storefront via the Akamai interstitial proof-of-work solver (curl_cffi chrome-impersonation session), same method as sibling passes GB (SR90)/DE (SR106)/ES (SR117). Checked: the full mega-menu tree embedded as JSON in the homepage's serverApp-state, robots.txt (no Claude-named disallow), and the site's own FR category sitemap (sitemap-home-categories-zh-fr-0.xml.gz, 668 URLs, full-text scanned for 'meilleur'/'vente'/'bestsell'/'popular'/'tendance'/'top-vente' substrings -- zero standalone hits). No standalone Bestsellers PLP exists anywhere on the FR storefront. The menu-tree JSON contains SEVEN entries with canonicalName='BESTSELLERS' / name='BESTSELLERS' -- one per department (E-I-A_D_BESTSELLERS_DORMITORIO/chambre/seoId 944, E-I-A_S_BESTSELLERS_SALON/salon, E-I-A_MUEBLES_BESTSELLERS_MUEBLES/meubles, E-I-M_BESTSELLERS_COMEDOR/cuisine-comedor, E-I-A_B_BESTSELLERS_BANO/salle-de-bain, E-I-A_F_BESTSELLERS_COSMETICA/parfums (seoId 1057), E-I-K_K_BESTSELLERS_KIDS/enfants) -- all share the identical non-genuine pattern already documented on GB/DE/ES: content.type='grid' (an in-page curated celement widget, not its own route), seo.seoExtraInfo.irrelevant=true, and each resolves via its seoId/keyword to that department's own general landing page rather than a separate filterable listing with its own URL or product count. None of the seven is present as a standalone entry anywhere in the FR sitemap. No /meilleures-ventes, /best-sellers, /populaires, /top-ventes, or equivalent standalone path exists in nav or sitemap. Concluding no genuine Bestsellers PLP exists on Zara Home FR, consistent with the GB/DE/ES sibling findings (4-for-4 on this platform so far).
